# Price the route, not just the pool.

> Price recurring pool service accounts after labor, drive time, chemicals, and overhead. Free private pool route pricing calculator for independent operators.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/pool-route-pricing/)

- [This calculator vs. a flat per-pool monthly rate](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/pool-route-pricing/vs-a-flat-per-pool-monthly-rate.html)
- [This calculator vs. Skimmer](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/pool-route-pricing/vs-skimmer.html)
